# KodeToCareer — AI, MERN Stack & Data Science Training Academy

> KodeToCareer is an industry-leading technology education academy in Noida, India offering 100% live cohorts, guaranteed paid internships, and 1-on-1 placement support in Full Stack MERN Web Development, Data Science & Machine Learning, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence, Java Full Stack, Cloud DevOps, MLOps, and UI/UX Product Design.

## Core Academies & Career Programs
- [MERN Stack Development + AI Integration](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/mern-stack-development): Master MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, and AI API integrations in 6 months with 15+ capstone projects.
- [Data Science & Machine Learning Core](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-science-machine-learning): Learn Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Power BI, and LLM fine-tuning in 6 months.
- [Data Analytics & Business Intelligence](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-analytics): Master Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI dashboards, and Python predictive modeling in 4 months.
- [Java Full Stack Developer Program](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/java-full-stack): Learn Core Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, microservices, and React/Angular frontends in 6 months.
- [Cloud Computing & DevOps Infrastructure](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/cloud-devops): Master AWS, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins CI/CD, and Terraform in 6 months.
- [Graphic Design + UI/UX Product Design](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/graphic-design-ui-ux): Learn Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, wireframing, and product design systems in 4 months.

## Free Developer Tools & Utilities
- [AI Resume Grader & ATS Score Checker](https://kodetocareer.com/free-tools/resume-grader): Instant AI audit for developer resumes with ATS optimization suggestions.
- [AI Technical Mock Interview Simulator](https://kodetocareer.com/free-tools/mock-interview): Interactive AI voice and text mock technical interview prep for software roles.
